meta.title: Navara — an open-source 3D globe map engine
meta.description: Navara is a highly extensible, general-purpose 3D globe map engine. It streams real-world geospatial data — satellite imagery, terrain, 3D city models, and vector data — onto an interactive globe and lets you style it for any use case.

intro.copyHtml: Navara is a highly extensible, general-purpose 3D globe map engine. It streams real-world geospatial data — satellite imagery, terrain, 3D city models, and vector data — onto an interactive globe, and lets you style it for any use case. From a simple basemap to photoreal scenes with atmosphere, sunlight, and shadows — the geospatial math runs in a Rust / WASM GIS engine distributed across Web Workers, so everything stays responsive even with large datasets.

values.title: Beautiful, instantly
values.desc: A photoreal scene comes up in a few lines of code.

values.title: Yours to control
values.desc: Tune atmosphere, clouds, water, and effects down to the last detail.

values.title: Layered, not complicated
values.desc: Combine the declarative API, plugins, and the low-level API in the same view.

values.title: A foundation you keep
values.desc: A renderer-agnostic Rust core — ready for WebGPU and native.

why.apiNote: Start declaratively, and drop down a layer only when you need to. Same engine, same data — no rewrites.

arch.h2: A headless GIS core, independent of the renderer.
arch.sub: On Three.js today. In any environment tomorrow.
arch.coreLabel: HEADLESS GIS CORE — RUST / WASM + BEVY ECS
arch.coreDesc: Tile management · LOD · coordinate transforms · spatial indexing · ellipsoid geometry
arch.midHtml: Rendering-ready Output (heavy work runs in Web Workers)

gallery.h2: GIS that stands as a picture.

maplibre.h2: Your styles and tiles, straight to 3D.
maplibre.copy: MapLibre, together with its open-source community, shaped modern web mapping. Navara is open source too (MIT / Apache-2.0) — and extends it into 3D.
items: Supports the MapLibre Style Spec: layers and expressions in the JSON you already know (MapLibre Style Plugin, in development)
Extends the expression system to 3D-native concepts such as terrain, atmosphere, and height
Standard support planned for MapLibre Tiles (MLT), the next-generation format

users.h2: Real products set the quality bar.
users.sub: Developed with real products and public-data use cases on the roadmap.

items.name: Re:Earth
items.desc: An open-source GIS platform developed by Eukarya. Navara is planned to be integrated as its 3D map engine.

items.name: PLATEAU
items.desc: Japan's open 3D city model project led by MLIT. City-scale rendering with PLATEAU's 3D Tiles is on the roadmap.

items.name: Hiroshima Archive
items.desc: A digital archive by the Hidenori Watanave Laboratory. The plan is to reimplement its Cesium version with Navara / Three.js for higher visual quality.
